lines.line: She's the Animated Woman by Quaternius. But none of the model's own animations are used.
Every frame, her pose is a handful of numbers. Hip height, thighs, knees, lean, nod, and arms.
Those become bone rotations. The legs are solved in 3D, from her real hip joints, to exactly where the feet belong.
Her hands came rigged, but frozen. Now each finger curls about an axis found from the rest pose.
One grip value takes her from an open hand, to a fist.
